log.text: M15 barrier: a fresh supply zone 1.13888 to 1.13932, an engulf (EG) zone: the last up candle before a close below its low.
Price left the barrier and came back to it (visit 3). Its confirmation is read on M1. The barrier is AGAINST the H1 direction (buy): the method expects only a rejection from it.
M1 CF: a QM (BO Structure) sell, a candle closed below 1.13834. A sell limit rests at that level for the pullback.

Price pulled back to the level: sell 1.13834, stop 1.13927 (0.00009 past the extreme 1.13918 made at the barrier, risk 0.00093), target 1.13556 (3R: the replay's own choice, the method names no fixed target here).
